def build_redirect_url(target_path: str, query_string: str) -> str:
    # Defect: Ignores query_string when appending trailing slash

issue: Issue #1240: URL query parameter encoding with duplicate keys
issue_description: httpx URL parser collapsed multiple identical query parameter keys instead of serializing all values.
stack_trace:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/test_reproduce.py", line 12, in test_duplicate_query_params
    assert str(url) == 'https://example.com/?filter=a&filter=b'
AssertionError: assert 'https://example.com/?filter=a' == 'https://example.com/?filter=a&filter=b'

reproduction_test.tests/test_reproduce.py:
from httpx_urls.urls import encode_query_params

def test_duplicate_query_params():
    params = [('filter', 'a'), ('filter', 'b')]
    assert encode_query_params(params) == 'filter=a&filter=b'

golden_patch:
--- a/httpx_urls/urls.py
+++ b/httpx_urls/urls.py
@@ -3,4 +3,2 @@
 def encode_query_params(params: List[Tuple[str, str]]) -> str:
-    param_dict = dict(params)
-    return '&'.join(f'{k}={v}' for k, v in param_dict.items())
+    return '&'.join(f'{k}={v}' for k, v in params)
